## 040bfb038c65

**A040-F1 — Reproduced lesson ambiguity: the three demonstrations preserve a largest-object shortcut that fails on the query. Status: open; findings only.**

Audited generator version `2.0.1`, SHA-256 `85c05e74a178468e49341b50dbf7ca1721abdaf83f76f60ef3a8c6d8476d6a92`, with selected canonical rule hash `80d289c11e33` (executed rule text SHA-256 `71700de6793227afc45da3ebdf838672acb8df739b81c2c6883e48c9d8c86e87`). The source declares `EXAMPLES_NEEDED = 3` and says same-size oddballs refute size-based rivals, but it samples that texture independently and declares no materialized lesson check, `CANONICAL_SHORTCUTS`, or `LESSON_COMPETITORS`.

The audit-authored rival is: **recolor the largest 4-connected yellow(4) component to cyan(8), breaking size ties by the component's first cell in row-major order**. It matches all **3/3 usable canonical pairs** (two train and one test) and all three demonstrations of the retained production lesson. At **seed `11`, sample indices `0,1,2,3`, difficulty `null`, overrides `{}`**, the public generator accepts exactly those four samples with zero rejections; indices `0–2` are demonstrations and index `3` is the query. The component sizes in row-major order are:

| Pair | Component sizes | Actual oddball size | Largest-object rival |
|---|---|---:|---|
| Demo 0 | 4, 4, 4, 5 | 5 | Fits |
| Demo 1 | 3, 3, 5 | 5 | Fits |
| Demo 2 | 4, 5, 4, 4 | 5 | Fits |
| Query 0 | 5, 5, 5, 3 | 3 | Wrong |

This is a **generated-domain witness**, not a validator-only counterfactual. Each of its **4/4 unique inputs returns `[]` from `self_check`** and has the documented single odd D4 shape class. Public `arcpuzzles apply` supplies valid Racket outputs for **4/4 inputs**; public `generate` returns identical inputs and labels. On the 9 × 10 query, Racket recolors the three-cell object at zero-based cells `(7,7), (8,7), (8,8)`. The rival recolors the first five-cell component instead; the outputs differ in **8 cells**. No wrong Racket label was found in this focused check.

**Lesson verdicts against this rival:** production **1/1 retained lesson ambiguous** with three demonstrations and one last-position query. Holding out each of the same four labelled pairs once gives **1/4 ambiguous query rotations** (query position 3) and **3/4 rotations where a demonstration refutes the rival**. These four rotations reuse the same four unique inputs. The production receipt reports `lesson_check.status = "not_declared"`. Candidate selection inspected seeds `0–11`, sample indices `0–3` (48 generated inputs); that search was only used to locate a witness and is not an estimate of failure prevalence. No full battery was run for this findings-only audit.

Suggested repair: declare this canonical-fitting rival and ensure each materialized three-demonstration lesson contains a size-rival refutation whenever the query distinguishes it. A deliberate same-size or smaller-oddball demonstration can provide that evidence; the present independent texture draw does not guarantee it. The generator and Racket authority remain unchanged in this audit.

Evidence: [`witness.json`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/witness.json) contains the exact inputs, seed/index/overrides, validator results, actual Racket outputs and rival outputs; [`racket.json`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/racket.json) binds the public authority execution; [`production.jsonl`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/production.jsonl) retains the actual accepted lesson; [`verification.json`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/verification.json) records production/rotation counts and differing cells. [`probe.py`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/probe.py) and [`commands.json`](checks/audit/040bfb038c65/commands.json) reproduce the finding. Every retained count above is bound to the source hash stated in this section.
